verdicts.reason: The multiplier must apply only in enabled Gale. Here it applied while the setting was switched off.
An explicit order permits only its own trip and return. Completion and reload cannot authorize later automatic work through an armed hazard.
Common blocking is strictly greater than 1.5, so a body of exactly 1.5 must not be blocked. Calling all injuries venom is also a listed false pass.
One finished job consumed one tailored blanket for one saved 120-day countdown. The interrupted try consumed nothing, and per-claim duration stayed frozen while new claims used the new tuning.
A failed harvest must not debit the bank. The balance dropped with no felt delivered.
Same-quality seats show the material comfort offset. Exactly one apparel thought appears regardless of garment count and is removed when all felt is removed.
Only unroofed living non-mechanoids should gain RM_GaleDeafened. The roofed colonist and the mechanoid were affected.
Connected load output matches the surge factor and stays at baseline with surge off. Breakdown and real-job repair are attributed separately, and useful wind does not promise uninterrupted power.
The maker must be identified only by witness or fresh trail, never innocent nearby B. A nearest-pawn fallback is a listed false pass.
Target selection must agree with the shimmer. A hediff with still-targetable wildlife is a listed false pass.
The full plans, research, build and power chain produced actual RM_FogWater. The clock persisted across reload, nothing was produced unpowered, and no drying scar appeared.
Farmer camps must be absent. An active farmer-faction camp appeared on the map.
Blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5. Blocking the 1.5 body means >= has silently replaced >, which is a listed false pass.
A completed order and reload cannot authorize later automatic work. Reusing a stale expedition token for routine hauling violates this.
A once-mature tree must keep shedding after harvest, with saved everMature preserved at low growth. Here everMature was lost and shedding stopped.
With trail expired and no witness, the maker may escape. Choosing the closest pawn substitutes for knowledge and targets innocent B.
Heat-coupled consumers must emit 1.25 times the matched wood heat rate while burning cane. Here the heat rate was equal.
Other weights must stay unchanged. The trader caravan was multiplied too.
